executive_verdict.authority_boundary: C22-A has NO authority to authorize training. Training remains strictly prohibited until explicit USER instruction is provided.

critical_discrepancies_resolved.resolution: Decomposed from physical rasters: 8,595,330 radiometric valid pixels - 194,270 excluded source label 9 pixels = 8,401,060 dense training class pixels. Sqrt-median weights derived exactly from 8,401,060.

critical_discrepancies_resolved.description: Background-collapse incorrectly classified as automatic invalid run
critical_discrepancies_resolved.resolution: Removed from invalid_conditions in diagnostic protocol. Model collapse is an empirical optimization outcome, not an execution/pipeline fault.

dataset_version_lineage.lineage_explanation: OPS02_v1.0.0_FROZEN suffered from narrative typographical ambiguity in early documentation (41/39 split text) and was updated in v1.0.1 to cryptographically bind exact manifest hashes. The underlying 212 GeoTIFFs, PNG masks, and partition assignments are bitwise identical.

provenance_metadata.control_vector_generation_method: w_c = sqrt(median(f_valid) / f_c) on 12 canonical dense classes across 132 TRAIN tiles (8,401,060 training pixels)

execution_and_parity_contracts.architecture_identity: U-Net with ResNet-18 Backbone (SMP Unet / torchvision ResNet-18 IMAGENET1K_V1, in_channels=1, classes=12)

full_initial_state_requirement.specification: The full initial model architecture (adapted conv1, encoder, decoder, segmentation head) must be instantiated, initialized, and serialized to initial_model_state.pt. Both control and treatment must clone this exact state dict pre-epoch 0.

rng_contract.specification: Captures Python random, NumPy RNG, PyTorch CPU, PyTorch CUDA, and DataLoader worker seed states to initial_rng_state.pt. Restored identically for control and treatment pre-epoch 0.

sampler_contract.specification: The exact sequence of sample indices across all epochs is precomputed once, saved to canonical_sample_schedule.json, and fed identically to both runs.

dataloader_contract.specification: Batch groupings and batch order are precomputed to canonical_batch_schedule.json. Both runs execute the identical batch sequences.

input_target_contract.tensor_format: input: [B, 1, 256, 256] float32 log1p standardized; target: [B, 256, 256] int64
input_target_contract.verification: Step 1 pre-forward input and target checksums assert bitwise match: assert control_input_checksum == treatment_input_checksum

loss_contract.loss_normalization: Standard PyTorch mean over non-ignored target pixels weighted by weight[target_i]

early_stopping_contract.shared_rule: patience = 10, min_epochs = 15, monitor = dev_mIoU_phenomena, mode = max
early_stopping_contract.scientific_posture: Identical early stopping rule is enforced. Optimization trajectories may naturally diverge due to differing loss vectors, potentially resulting in different stopping epochs. This is a legitimate empirical outcome, not a protocol violation.

metric_contract.threshold_policy: NO_ARBITRARY_THRESHOLDS. Report exact control_mIoU, treatment_mIoU, and delta_mIoU descriptively without manufacturing statistical significance from pixel counts.

invalid_conditions: NaN or Inf encountered in loss, logits, or gradient tensors
Initial model state SHA256 mismatch between control and treatment
Batch schedule or sample sequence mismatch
Optimizer or scheduler state mismatch before step 1
BatchNorm configuration or initial running stats mismatch
Firewall breach: any access to HOLDOUT partition (count > 0) or Part-III directory
Unhandled runtime exceptions, OOM, or premature process crash
invalid_run_contract.model_collapse_policy: Degenerate or poor model outputs (including complete background-collapse or zero foreground predictions) are RECORDED and investigated as observed model behavior under the test protocol. They do NOT automatically invalidate the run unless accompanied by an implementation, numerical, or protocol integrity failure.
invalid_run_contract.gradient_norm_policy: Large but finite gradient norms are RECORDED and tracked, not automatically invalidated. Zero gradients are RECORDED and investigated.

firewall_and_safety_governance.zero_training_compliance: STRICTLY_ENFORCED (Zero model training initiated in C22-A)
firewall_and_safety_governance.zero_kaggle_compliance: STRICTLY_ENFORCED (Zero Kaggle processes launched in C22-A)
firewall_and_safety_governance.git_hygiene: Zero commits, zero pushes, zero resets, zero stashes, tracked modifications (.gitignore, dataset.py) intact

software_environment_requirements.cuda_requirement: CUDA 12.x / Tesla T4 or equivalent deterministic GPU
